## What is not allowed

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

## Try it

Try out various languages and styles on the [Chroma Playground](https://swapoff.org/chroma/playground/).

## Command-line Interface

A command-line interface to Chroma is included.

Binaries are available to install from [the releases page](https://github.com/alecthomas/chroma/releases).

### Usage with `less`

The CLI can be used as a preprocessor to colorise output of `less(1)`,
see documentation for the `LESSOPEN` environment variable.

The `--fail` flag can be used to suppress output and return with exit status
1 to facilitate falling back to some other preprocessor in case chroma
does not resolve a specific lexer to use for the given file. For example:

```shell
export LESSOPEN='| p() { chroma --fail "$1" || cat "$1"; }; p "%s"'
```

Replace `cat` with your favourite fallback preprocessor.

When invoked as `.lessfilter`, the `--fail` flag is automatically turned
on under the hood for easy integration with [lesspipe shipping with
Debian and derivatives](https://manpages.debian.org/lesspipe#USER_DEFINED_FILTERS);
for that setup the `chroma` executable can be just symlinked to `~/.lessfilter`.

## Projects using Chroma

* [`moor`](https://github.com/walles/moor) is a full-blown pager that colorizes
  its input using Chroma
* [Hugo](https://gohugo.io/) is a static site generator that [uses Chroma for syntax
  highlighting code examples](https://gohugo.io/content-management/syntax-highlighting/)

func TestGroups(t *testing.T) {
	re := MustCompile(`(a)(?:b)(?<n>c)(d)`, 0)
	if re.NumGroups() != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("numgroups %d", re.NumGroups())
	}
	caps := re.MatchAt([]rune("abcd"), 0)
	// .NET numbering: unnamed first: a=1, d=2, named c=3
	if caps[2] != 0 || caps[3] != 1 {
		t.Errorf("group1 %v", caps)
	}
	if caps[4] != 3 || caps[5] != 4 {
		t.Errorf("group2 %v", caps)
	}
	if caps[6] != 2 || caps[7] != 3 {
		t.Errorf("group3 %v", caps)
	}
	if re.GroupIndex("n") != 3 {
		t.Errorf("named index")
	}

	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i] < out[j] })
	return out
}

	if n, ok := tokenTypeNames[t]; ok {

	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("TokenType(%d)", int(t))

	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s does not belong to TokenType values", s)
}

// Parent returns the parent type (sub category, then category, then none).
func (t TokenType) Parent() TokenType {
	if t%100 != 0 {
		return t / 100 * 100
	}
	if t%1000 != 0 {
		return t / 1000 * 1000
	}
	return 0
}

	return t / 1000 * 1000
}

	if t%100 == 0 {
		return t
	}
	return t / 100 * 100

	return t/1000 == other/1000
}

// InSubCategory returns true if t is in the given sub category.
func (t TokenType) InSubCategory(other TokenType) bool {
	return t/100 == other/100
}

	return Literator(Token{Type: t, Value: groups[0]})

func (t TokenType) EmitterKind() string { return "token" }

// SortedStandardTypes returns the standard token types sorted by value.
func SortedStandardTypes() []TokenType {
	out := make([]TokenType, 0, len(StandardTypes))
	for t := range StandardTypes {
		out = append(out, t)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i] < out[j] })
	return out
}

func (t TokenType) String() string {
	if n, ok := tokenTypeNames[t]; ok {
		return n
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("TokenType(%d)", int(t))
}

// TokenTypeString parses a token type name.
func TokenTypeString(s string) (TokenType, error) {
	if t, ok := tokenTypeByName[s]; ok {
		return t, nil
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s does not belong to TokenType values", s)
}

// Parent returns the parent type (sub category, then category, then none).
func (t TokenType) Parent() TokenType {
	if t%100 != 0 {
		return t / 100 * 100
	}
	if t%1000 != 0 {
		return t / 1000 * 1000
	}
	return 0
}

// Category returns the top level category of the token type.
func (t TokenType) Category() TokenType {
	return t / 1000 * 1000
}

// SubCategory returns the sub category of the token type.
func (t TokenType) SubCategory() TokenType {
	if t%100 == 0 {
		return t
	}
	return t / 100 * 100
}

// InCategory returns true if t is in the given category.
func (t TokenType) InCategory(other TokenType) bool {
	return t/1000 == other/1000
}

// InSubCategory returns true if t is in the given sub category.
func (t TokenType) InSubCategory(other TokenType) bool {
	return t/100 == other/100
}

// Emit implements Emitter for TokenType.
func (t TokenType) Emit(groups []string, state *LexerState) Iterator {
	return Literator(Token{Type: t, Value: groups[0]})
}

// EmitterKind implements Emitter.
func (t TokenType) EmitterKind() string { return "token" }

def _make_follow_state(compound, _label=_label, _label_compound=_label_compound, _nl=_nl, _space=_space,
                       _start_label=_start_label, _token=_token, _token_compound=_token_compound, _ws=_ws):
    suffix = '/compound' if compound else ''
    state = []
    if compound:
        state.append((r'(?=\))', Text, '#pop'))
    state += [
        (r'%s([%s]*)(%s)(.*)' % (_start_label, _ws, _label_compound if compound else _label), bygroups(Text, Punctuation, Text, NameLabel, CommentSingle)),
        include('redirect%s' % suffix),
        (r'(?=[%s])' % _nl, Text, '#pop'),
        (r'\|\|?|&&?', Punctuation, '#pop'),
        include('text'),
    ]
    return state

def _make_arithmetic_state(compound, _nl=_nl, _punct=_punct, _string=_string, _variable=_variable, _ws=_ws, _nlws=_nlws):
    op = r'=+\-*/!~'
    state = []
    if compound:
        state.append((r'(?=\))', Text, '#pop'))
    state += [
        (r'0[0-7]+', LiteralNumberOct),
        (r'0x[\da-f]+', LiteralNumberHex),
        (r'\d+', LiteralNumberInteger),
        (r'[(),]+', Punctuation),
        (r'([%s]|%%|\^\^)+' % op, Operator),
        (r'(%s|%s|(\^[%s]?)?[^()%s%%\^"%s%s]|\^[%s]?%s)+' % (_string, _variable, _nl, op, _nlws, _punct, _nlws, r'[^)]' if compound else r'[\w\W]'), using('Batchfile')),
        (r'(?=[\x00|&])', Text, '#pop'),
        include('follow'),
    ]
    return state

def _make_call_state(compound, _label=_label, _label_compound=_label_compound):
    state = []

        state.append((r'(?=\))', Text, '#pop'))
    state.append((r'(:?)(%s)' % (_label_compound if compound else _label), bygroups(Punctuation, NameLabel), '#pop'))
    return state

def _make_label_state(compound, _label=_label, _label_compound=_label_compound, _nl=_nl, _punct=_punct, _string=_string, _variable=_variable):
    state = []
    if compound:
        state.append((r'(?=\))', Text, '#pop'))
    state.append((r'(%s?)((?:%s|%s|\^[%s]?%s|[^"%%^%s%s%s])*)' % (_label_compound if compound else _label, _string, _variable, _nl, r'[^)]' if compound else r'[\w\W]', _nl, _punct, r')' if compound else ''),

    return state

def _make_redirect_state(compound, _core_token_compound=_core_token_compound, _nl=_nl, _punct=_punct, _stoken=_stoken, _string=_string, _space=_space, _variable=_variable, _nlws=_nlws):
    stoken_compound = (r'(?:[%s]+|(?:%s|%s|%s)+)' % (_punct, _string, _variable, _core_token_compound))
    return [
        (r'((?:(?<=[%s])\d)?)(>>?&|<&)([%s]*)(\d)' % (_nlws, _nlws), bygroups(LiteralNumberInteger, Punctuation, Text, LiteralNumberInteger)),
        (r'((?:(?<=[%s])(?<!\^[%s])\d)?)(>>?|<)(%s?%s)' % (_nlws, _nl, _space, stoken_compound if compound else _stoken), bygroups(LiteralNumberInteger, Punctuation, using('Batchfile'))),

_ws1 = r'\s*(?:/[*].*?[*]/\s*)?'

def c_whitespace(selfname):
    return [
        (r'^#if\s+0', CommentPreproc, 'if0'),
        (r'^#', CommentPreproc, 'macro'),
        (r'^(' + _ws1 + r')(#if\s+0)', bygroups(usingself('root'), CommentPreproc), 'if0'),
        (r'^(' + _ws1 + r')(#)', bygroups(usingself('root'), CommentPreproc), 'macro'),
        (r'\n', TextWhitespace),
        (r'\s+', TextWhitespace),

        (r'//(\n|[\w\W]*?[^\\]\n)', CommentSingle),
        (r'/(\\\n)?[*][\w\W]*?[*](\\\n)?/', CommentMultiline),
        (r'/(\\\n)?[*][\w\W]*', CommentMultiline),

def c_statements(extra_keywords=(), extra_types=(), extra_builtins=(), reserved=(), cpp=False):
    rules = [
        (r'(L?)(")', bygroups(LiteralStringAffix, LiteralString), 'string'),
        (r"(L?)(')(\\.|\\[0-7]{1,3}|\\x[a-fA-F0-9]{1,2}|[^\\\'\n])(')", bygroups(LiteralStringAffix, LiteralStringChar, LiteralStringChar, LiteralStringChar)),
        (r'(\d+\.\d*|\.\d+|\d+)[eE][+-]?\d+[LlUu]*', LiteralNumberFloat),
        (r'(\d+\.\d*|\.\d+|\d+[fF])[fF]?', LiteralNumberFloat),
        (r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+[LlUu]*', LiteralNumberHex),
        (r'0[0-7]+[LlUu]*', LiteralNumberOct),
        (r'\d+[LlUu]*', LiteralNumberInteger),
        (r'\*/', Error),
        (r'[~!%^&*+=|?:<>/-]', Operator),
        (r'[()\[\],.]', Punctuation),
        (words(list(C_KEYWORDS) + list(extra_keywords), suffix=r'\b'), Keyword),
        (r'(bool|int|long|float|short|double|char((8|16|32)_t)?|unsigned|signed|void|u?int(_fast|_least|)(8|16|32|64)_t)\b', KeywordType),
        (words(['inline', '_inline', '__inline', 'naked', 'restrict', 'thread', 'typename'] + list(reserved), suffix=r'\b'), KeywordReserved),
        (r'(__m(128i|128d|128|64))\b', KeywordReserved),

                'int64', 'try', 'leave', 'wchar_t', 'w64', 'unaligned', 'raise', 'noop', 'identifier', 'forceinline', 'assume'],
               prefix=r'__', suffix=r'\b'), KeywordReserved),
        (r'(true|false|NULL)\b', NameBuiltin),

    if extra_types:
        rules.append((words(list(extra_types), suffix=r'\b'), KeywordType))
    if extra_builtins:

    ]

def c_rules(name, statements, extra_root=(), extra_states=None):
    rules = {
        'whitespace': c_whitespace(name),
        'statements': statements,
        'root': [
            include('whitespace'),
            (r'((?:[\w*\s])+?(?:\s|[*]))([a-zA-Z_]\w*)(\s*\([^;]*?\))([^;{]*)(\{)',
             bygroups(usingself('root'), NameFunction, usingself('root'), usingself('root'), Punctuation), 'function'),
            (r'((?:[\w*\s])+?(?:\s|[*]))([a-zA-Z_]\w*)(\s*\([^;]*?\))([^;]*)(;)',
             bygroups(usingself('root'), NameFunction, usingself('root'), usingself('root'), Punctuation)),
        ] + list(extra_root) + [
            default('statement'),
        ],
        'statement': [
            include('whitespace'),
            include('statements'),
            (r'[{}]', Punctuation),
            (r';', Punctuation, '#pop'),
        ],
        'function': [
            include('whitespace'),
            include('statements'),
            (r';', Punctuation),
            (r'\{', Punctuation, '#push'),
            (r'\}', Punctuation, '#pop'),
        ],
        'string': [
            (r'"', LiteralString, '#pop'),
            (r'\\([\\abfnrtv"\']|x[a-fA-F0-9]{2,4}|u[a-fA-F0-9]{4}|U[a-fA-F0-9]{8}|[0-7]{1,3})', LiteralStringEscape),
            (r'[^\\"\n]+', LiteralString),
            (r'\\\n', LiteralString),
            (r'\\', LiteralString),
        ],
        'macro': [
            (r'(include)(' + _ws1 + r')([^\n]+)', bygroups(CommentPreproc, Text, CommentPreprocFile)),
            (r'[^/\n]+', CommentPreproc),
            (r'/[*](.|\n)*?[*]/', CommentMultiline),
            (r'//.*?\n', CommentSingle, '#pop'),
            (r'/', CommentPreproc),
            (r'(?<=\\)\n', CommentPreproc),
            (r'\n', CommentPreproc, '#pop'),
        ],
        'if0': [
            (r'^\s*#if.*?(?<!\\)\n', CommentPreproc, '#push'),
            (r'^\s*#el(?:se|if).*\n', CommentPreproc, '#pop'),
            (r'^\s*#endif.*?(?<!\\)\n', CommentPreproc, '#pop'),
            (r'.*?\n', Comment),
        ],
    }
    if extra_states:
        rules.update(extra_states)
    return rules
